name: Kawazoe Miki
source:
Shuuichi's daughter. She cannot restrain her yearning for her father since she was young, so she confessed her feelings and sought sexual relations with him. 

Calm, collected, mature, blunt and prone to sarcasm. She's also one to speak in an abusive language. However, those traits of hers are just bluffs to make her look like an adult, and gloss over her youthfulness. In reality, she's lonely, very emotional, and wants someone to depend on and spoil her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/mydaugther/qmd001/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
